sk.overview: The DRHP frames the sector using the commissioned '1Lattice Report' (Molecular Diagnostics Industry Report dated July 24, 2026). Diagnostics is positioned as the cornerstone of India's healthcare sector, split into in vitro diagnostics (pathology tests on samples) and in vivo diagnostics (radiology). Within IVD, molecular diagnostics analyses nucleic acids (DNA/RNA) via PCR, isothermal amplification, nucleic acid hybridisation and microarrays to detect infectious disease, oncology and genetic conditions.
